text: Good morning, everyone! I started on the green, then sat a while on the bench outside the cottage, listening to the hum of my bees nearby. After that I took a cool swim in the pond, and now I'm here with you, feeling bright and ready. It's been a lovely, quiet morning.
speaker: ada

text: Um, hi. I'm Bo. My morning was quiet. I woke on the green at dawn, gave a little wave, and walked down to the pond hall. I wish I had my instrument here, but I'm happy to listen.
speaker: bo
